limits: One current-library map per authored size, ten direct 24x18 cases, twenty concave/one-portal/portalless/narrow cases, four single-portal dumbbells with 2/3-cell necks at seeds 3/25, and two multiportal side-lobe cases. Historical checkpoint module with current shared dependencies. Exact primary elements/traces, two-cell spacing, fill/margins, portal promises and unchanged post-door reachability are checked. Independent reach audit floods integer cell-intersection hunter stands with swept-clearance cardinal edges; it reports candidate, walkable and reachable nodes, and fails if a previously reachable node remains walkable but becomes disconnected. Newly blocked nodes are reported separately. Up to 20 spatially spread baseline loot sites per case are checked with contestant-sized findRegionRoute from the shared baseline anchor; only newly unreachable retained sites fail. This is bounded sampled geometry, not a proof of continuous-space reachability; removed sampled loot and pre-existing inaccessible targets are reported separately. No delegation acceptance rate, human balance or exhaustive coverage claimed.
